**Job Description

**_Do you enjoy designing highly available network solutions where BGP failover happens seamlessly and downtime is measured in milliseconds? Are you motivated by ownership, technical excellence, and continuous development? If so, Netcompany is looking for a Senior Network Engineer to help drive and evolve our data center and enterprise network infrastructure.

_**Responsibilities And Technologies

**Netcompany Operations is a well-established operations organization responsible for everything from business- and mission-critical application operations to infrastructure management across two modern data centers.

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will join our Network Team, which is part of the broader Infrastructure organization. We deliver secure and reliable solutions within our private cloud environments, supporting critical systems for both public and private sector customers.

You will be working with the operation, maintenance, and evolution of Netcompany’s data center and enterprise network infrastructure. You will work on complex, business-critical initiatives spanning the entire networking domain, with opportunities tailored to support your professional growth and career development.

The role offers technical ownership and direct influence on solutions delivered to public-sector and mission-critical customers. In addition, you will work with security as well as automation and DevOps principles within networking, including stabilization and continuous development—from core routing to security and WAN/edge.

**Your Responsibilites Will Typically Include

**

• Operating, troubleshooting, expanding, and designing network solutions across data center and enterprise/campus environments.

• Enhancing network security through segmentation, policy-based routing (PBR), access control, SIEM and IPS.

• Managing and optimizing Fortinet firewalls, Cisco ASR routers, ACI-switching fabric and related data center technologies.

• Automation/DevOps and Infrastructure as Code initiatives using Python, Ansible, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, templates, pipelines, and code reviews.

• Collaborating closely with specialists across server, storage, and security domains while helping shape the technical direction of the network platform..

**About You

**You are proactive, accountable, and delivery-focused. You take accountability for your work, approach solutions with a structured and analytical mindset, help establish standards and best practices, and contribute to the continuous improvement of both the team and the platform. In addition, you are comfortable taking the lead and approach challenges in a structured and methodical manner.

**To Succeed In This Role, You

**

• Hold a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, network engineering, information technology, or a related field, or possess an equivalent level of qualification.

• Have several years of experience in a similar networking role.

• Have a solid understanding of scripting, automation, and Infrastructure as Code principles.

• Have hands-on experience with firewalls and network security technologies, preferably Fortinet and/or Cisco combined with strong practical experience with enterprise routing/switching, and LAN/WAN environments.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Employment is contingent upon your ability to obtain and maintain security clearance from the Danish Security and Intelligence Service (PET).

**Continue developing with us

**At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

**Join an inclusive community

**At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

**Send us an application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

_All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

_We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

**The Opportunity

**We are looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our Product Engineering organization and help build the digital experiences that teams, coaches, and athletes rely on every week.

In this role, you will work across the full stack—developing scalable backend services, designing resilient APIs, and building responsive, intuitive web interfaces. You’ll be part of a cross-functional product team partnering closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, native mobile engineers, and platform specialists to take ideas from concept to production.

Your work directly influences user engagement, product adoption, and long-term platform value. Whether it involves streamlining how users access and interact with our tools or helping them unlock deeper insights from their matchday media, you will build software that turns video and match data into meaningful, everyday habits for sports communities worldwide.

**What You Will Do

**

• Build and maintain full-stack capabilities, developing scalable backend APIs and high-quality web interfaces.

• Participate in the complete product lifecycle: from initial problem discovery, ideation, feature scoping, technical planning, design discussions, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing iteration based on user data.

• Partner with our native iOS and Android engineers to ensure backend systems and API contracts seamlessly support mobile-first user flows.

• Design clean data models, reliable integrations, and maintainable services with an eye toward performance and scale.

• Incorporate modern AI development tools into your workflow to iterate quickly and build thoughtful software solutions.

• Contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, and shared ownership of the team’s systems.

**What You Could Bring

**

• 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally in a product-led environment.

• Experience working across frontend and backend development.

• A product mindset, with an interest in understanding real user problems and working with Product and Design to turn them into thoughtful technical solutions.

• Backend experience using Python, Rust, or another comparable language, together with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.

• Frontend experience using TypeScript or JavaScript and a modern SPA framework such as React, Vue, or Angular.

• Experience building reliable RESTful or GraphQL APIs for web or native mobile applications.

• A thoughtful approach to automated testing, CI/CD, and maintaining production-quality systems.

• Curiosity about modern AI development tools and how they can support everyday engineering workflows

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY

**VELUX is the world's most recognised brand in roof windows and skylights, with a genuine mission: creating better living environments through daylight and fresh air. Backed by a foundation with a long-term ownership philosophy, this is a company that thinks in decades, not quarters.

IT in VELUX is entering a new chapter. A new strategy is taking shape, it is high on the Group agenda, and it comes with a clear long-term view of where we are going. At its heart is, of course AI and all the new tech, but even more so, are the platforms that run the business: SAP and Workday, supporting Finance, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, and People & Organisation.

With a strong foundation already in place, we’re now looking for a leader to take it to the next level - evolving from classic ERP toward AI-enabled ways of working. For a leader who enjoys transformation, wants to shape a roadmap rather than simply run one, and gets energy from solving real problems, this role is worth a conversation.

**What You Will Lead

**You will be accountable for the strategy, delivery, and operation of the enterprise platforms behind VELUX global support functions and be a leader of leaders.

As part of a newly established IT leadership team, reporting to the CIO, you will contribute to the strategic IT agenda beyond your own area. You will own the budget, the key vendor relationships, and the portfolio of programmes across the support functions.

**What The Role Actually Involves

****Stabilising the core and delivering upgrades

**You’ll lead our work on platform reliability: setting up a clear roadmap, solving problems at their source, and keeping stakeholders informed and supported along the way.

**Rethinking the support model

**You’ll have the opportunity to reshape our SAP and Workday support model, building on what works today, including our partnership with an external provider, and shaping how it evolves.

**Prioritising with the business

**The transformation has strong backing, and a big part of the role is making sure effort goes where it creates the most value. With an established PMO behind you, you’ll strengthen portfolio governance and build alignment on priorities.

**Leading the AI shift

**AI is changing everything, including traditional systems. You will help define what AI-enabled ways of working mean for our applications and for our organisation. It is new ground for everyone, and mindset matters as much as technology.

**Who We Are Looking For

**You’re a hands-on IT leader who thinks strategically but isn’t afraid to get into the details. When something breaks, you look past the quick fix to find the real cause, bring the right people together, and make sure it gets properly resolved. People trust you because you deliver on what you promise.

You work in a lean, practical way, and when setting priorities, you involve people rather than handing down a list. You help stakeholders reach a shared view of what matters most, while keeping the conversation focused and constructive.

We are particularly interested in candidates who bring:

• 10+ years of IT leadership, including leading global, multi-disciplinary organisations.

• Experience with enterprise SAP landscapes across Finance, Sales, and Operations/Supply Chain; S/4HANA experience is a strong advantage.

• Experience with HR technology platforms, ideally Workday is an advantage.

• A track record of leading large upgrades and multi-year transformations in a global, matrixed organisation.

• Strong vendor management, including contracts with global system integrators and managed-service providers.

• Curiosity about AI and automation, and a practical view on how they can change the way we work.

• Experience from a manufacturing company is a distinct advantage, and from the building materials industry is a plus.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, “courage” and “mutual respect” define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential.

That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

What if developers could spend less time navigating complexity and more time building great technology?

Join Pandora as our Lead Engineer, Developer Experience and help shape how engineering teams build, deliver and operate software at scale.

You will lead the implementation and evolution of our Developer Experience platform and Developer Portal strategy, using Port.io as the foundation for a simpler, more connected and increasingly self-service engineering environment.

This is an opportunity to influence Developer Experience across a global technology organisation. You will help reduce friction throughout the software development lifecycle, improve visibility and ownership of software assets, and create practical standards and capabilities that enable engineering teams to move faster and with greater confidence.

**As a technical leader within our DevOps & Operational Excellence team, you will:

• Own the architecture of our software catalogue, including metadata, service ownership and portal governance.

jobs.occupation: DevOps / Platform Engineer — Reliability, Performance & Production Ownership
jobs.description:
DevOps / Platform Engineer — Fully Remote, Performance & Production Ownership

Want to work fully remotely with real freedom and ownership while operating high-throughput, low-latency systems that serve billions of shoppers?

For the right person, this is a high-trust role where you have flexibility in how you structure your work and the opportunity to make a significant impact on the technology behind billions of e-commerce experiences.

We’re building the infrastructure behind better e-commerce experiences for billions of shoppers every year.

Our systems serve more than 2,000 requests per second. Our in-house search engine delivers a p50 latency of sub-ms, while our entire infrastructure maintains 99.998% uptime.

We work with modern technology, use AI as a fundamental part of how we build, and continuously push the limits of reliability, performance, and innovation. Our goal is simple: connect e-commerce shoppers with the right products at the right time while helping merchants create a better customer experience and improve their bottom line.

We’re proud of the systems we’ve built—and we want someone who is excited to help make them even faster, more reliable, and more capable.

This job will be perfect for you if

• You enjoy operating high-throughput production systems where latency, reliability, and customer impact matter

• You care deeply about reliability, latency, throughput, and system performance

• You can investigate problems across infrastructure, application code, databases, queues, and networks

• You are comfortable reading, writing, debugging, and optimising production code

• You proactively identify failure scenarios before they become incidents

• You build automation and tooling instead of accepting repetitive manual work

• You enjoy improving CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, and developer experience

• You have handled serious production incidents and understand the responsibility that comes with on-call

• You think beyond whether a deployment succeeded and care about how the system behaves afterwards

• You can communicate clearly during incidents and take ownership when things matter

• You are curious about new technology and enjoy finding better ways to build and operate systems

• You want to work closely with software engineers rather than treating infrastructure as a separate world

• You thrive in a remote environment where freedom is matched by responsibility

A normal day for you

No two days will be the same, but your work might include:

• Investigating why a service, query, or piece of application code is slower than it should be

• Improving the reliability and performance of systems serving thousands of requests per second

• Reviewing metrics, traces, logs, and alerts to identify issues before they affect customers

• Designing and implementing infrastructure, automation, and internal tooling

• Writing, reviewing, debugging, and optimising production code

• Working with developers to improve how systems are built, deployed, and operated

• Responding to incidents when needed, then making sure the underlying problem is permanently addressed

• Exploring how new technologies and AI-powered tools can improve our engineering workflow

• Thinking proactively about scaling, capacity, resilience, and potential failure scenarios

AI is part of the job

We’re an AI-first company. AI and agentic coding are already part of how we build, investigate, automate, and improve systems.

You should already be comfortable using AI in your daily engineering workflow—for example, to investigate incidents, generate and review code, build internal tooling, automate operational work, and improve your own productivity.

How we work

This role can be fully remote for the right person.

We believe in giving people the freedom to structure their work in a way that helps them perform at their best. We care about impact, ownership, communication, and results—not about watching when or where you work.

You’ll need to work with meaningful overlap during CET working hours and participate in our PagerDuty/on-call rotation. Freedom comes with responsibility, especially when you are responsible for production systems.

On-call includes holidays

If you are scheduled to be on call and a genuine production alarm goes off—whether that is on a normal weekday, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year’s Eve, or New Year’s Day—you are expected to respond, take ownership, and stay with the issue until our systems are fully up and running again.

This is an important part of the role and is not optional. We are looking for someone who genuinely stands behind their work and understands that production ownership sometimes means being there when things go wrong.

At the same time, your goal is to make this situation as rare as possible. The best engineer is not the person who enjoys firefighting every holiday, but the person who builds reliable systems, strong monitoring, and effective automation so that firefighting is never needed.

How to apply

Instead of starting with a traditional cover letter, please send us a maximum 10-minute video.

We are hiring a human being—not AI-generated slop, a spotless resume, or someone who simply knows how to present the right keywords. We know the kind of person we are looking for, but the process also needs to be mutual. You should get the opportunity to meet the people behind the company and decide whether this is the right environment for you.

That is why we want to meet you upfront and see how you think, communicate, and explain your experience—not only evaluate what is written on paper.

• The production systems you have owned

• A difficult reliability or performance problem you solved

• How you approach incidents and on-call responsibility

• How you currently use AI and agentic coding

• Why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role

• What you are looking for in your next team and role

You may also include a short written example of a system that was slow, unreliable, or difficult to operate. Explain how you found the root cause, what you changed, and what improved afterwards.

If you are primarily an infrastructure administrator, this probably isn’t the right role. If you are a production-minded software engineer who enjoys making systems faster, more reliable, and easier to operate, we would love to hear from you.
